sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def find_player(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
            cr,cc=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2
            a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
            if a[cr][cc]=='B': return (r0,c0)
    return None
print("before probe player:",find_player(current_frame))
action(['DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'])
print("after 5xDOWN player:",find_player(current_frame))
print("last result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
